memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for initial consultation with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) on 2025-04-07 at 10:00 am. Patient to bring prior reports and list of current medications.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports mild lower back pain radiating to left thigh, aggravated by prolonged sitting; able to perform ADLs independently.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: No depressive symptoms reported; affect stable.
carers: Husband Rajesh, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay active and manage my liver and back pain so I can continue working."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg TDS
rosuvastatin 5 mg OD
pregabalin 75 mg BD
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Liver Function Test: ALT 38 U/L (7-35), AST 32 U/L (8-33).
Platelet count: 210 x10^9/L (150-400).
Fasting Lipid Profile: Cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200), Triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100).
Abdominal Ultrasound: Mild hepatic steatosis, no focal lesion, spleen normal.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Started new meds yesterday. Notice mild nausea after diclofenac, but back pain improved slightly. Liver feels fine. No new symptoms.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment scheduled with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) on 2025-07-07 at 09:30 am. Patient advised to fast for lipid profile.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Back pain reduced to occasional ache; able to walk 30 mins without discomfort. Liver discomfort none.
cognition: Not due for annual Mini-Cog yet.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin, pregabalin, diclofenac, methylcobalamin). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Mood stable, no anxiety reported.
carers: Husband Rajesh, spouse.
goals: "I want to keep working without pain and maintain liver health."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pregabalin increased to 150 mg BD
rosuvastatin continued 5 mg OD
silymarin continued 140 mg TDS
diclofenac continued 50 mg BD after food
methylcobalamin continued 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Liver Function Test: ALT 34 U/L, AST 30 U/L.
Fasting Lipid Profile: Cholesterol 202 mg/dL, Triglycerides 158 mg/dL, HDL 50 mg/dL, LDL 124 mg/dL.
Platelet count: 208 x10^9/L.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MRI Lumbar Spine: L4-L5 disc bulge causing mild left-sided nerve root compression, no canal stenosis. No malignant changes.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for review with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) on 2025-10-07 at 11:00 am. Patient to bring pain diary.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports occasional sciatica flare after long drives; otherwise functional.
cognition: Annual Mini-Cog performed; score 3/5 (negative).
falls: One fall reported last month while getting out of auto-rickshaw, no injury; gait slightly antalgic left; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise and proper footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin, pregabalin 150 mg BD, diclofenac, methylcobalamin). Polypharmacy – review Beers criteria.
mood: Mild frustration about pain; otherwise affect normal.
carers: Husband Rajesh, spouse.
goals: "I want to reduce flare-ups and stay independent."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg TDS
rosuvastatin 5 mg OD
pregabalin 150 mg BD
diclofenac stopped due to gastric upset
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
add: etoricoxib 60 mg OD for breakthrough pain

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Abdominal Ultrasound: Steatosis unchanged, liver size normal, no focal lesions.
Liver Function Test: ALT 36 U/L, AST 33 U/L.
Platelet count: 210 x10^9/L.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Visit scheduled with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) on 2026-01-07 at 10:15 am for medication review and fall prevention.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Improved mobility; able to climb stairs without pain; occasional mild back ache after long sitting.
cognition: Not due for yearly Mini-Cog.
falls: No further falls in past 3 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline) – continue strengthening exercises.
medicines: 5 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin, pregabalin 150 mg BD, methylcobalamin, etoricoxib 60 mg OD). Polypharmacy – review Beers criteria.
mood: Mood good; reports satisfaction with pain control.
carers: Husband Rajesh, spouse.
goals: "I want to maintain current function and avoid medication side effects."

memories.text:
